event_push_no_external_url.title: Imou event push has no callback URL
event_push_no_external_url.description: Event push is enabled but Home Assistant could not build an external webhook URL. Set **Settings → System → Network → Home Assistant URL**, or enter a manual callback URL in Imou Life options.

event_push_callback_failed.title: Imou event push registration failed
event_push_callback_failed.description: Home Assistant could not register the message callback with Imou Open Platform. Check the callback URL and your AppId resource quota, then reload the integration.

data_description.update_interval: How often to poll device status from Imou cloud. Default 60s, range 30-900s.
data_description.download_snap_wait_time: Seconds to wait before downloading a camera snapshot. Default 3s.
data_description.live_resolution: Camera live stream resolution. HD = high definition, SD = standard.
data_description.live_protocol: Video stream protocol. Usually https is fine.
data_description.rotation_duration: How long a single PTZ button press moves. Default 500ms.
data_description.enable_event_push: When enabled, Imou cloud will push alarm events to your HA in real time. Requires a publicly accessible URL (domain/DDNS). Messages are also synced to the Imou app.
data_description.webhook_url: The URL where Imou cloud sends alarm messages. Leave empty to auto-generate (requires HA external URL configured). To set manually, enter full URL like: https://yourdomain:8123/api/webhook/xxxxx
data_description.event_push_types: Select which message types to receive. alarm = device alarms (smoke/gas/human/motion etc.), deviceStatus = online/offline, iot = IoT device messages, numberstat = people counting, faceAnalysis = face detection.
data_description.notify_services:
Where to send alarm notifications. Enter HA action names, separate with commas.
Example: qiyewechat.send → WeChat Work
Example: notify.mobile_app_xxx → HA APP push
Both: qiyewechat.send,notify.mobile_app_xxx
Leave empty to skip (alarm events still fire for automations).
